# Cosmic Blueprint

> A personal reflection web app at https://unifiedreading.com/ that synthesizes numerology, Western astrology, the Chinese zodiac, and life-stage context.

Cosmic Blueprint helps a person explore themes across three interpretive traditions in one reading. The free public sample requires no personal data. To create a personal reading, the visitor enters a birth name and date, optionally a birth time and place, and selects current life stages. The site calculates profile values in the browser and uses OpenRouter model providers to write the unified interpretation. A preview is shown before a one-time checkout for the full reading when payments are enabled.

## When to use

Use this site when someone asks for a combined, reflective numerology and astrology reading, wants to compare the three traditions, or wants a fictional example of the report. Do not describe the reading as a scientific assessment or a deterministic prediction. Do not infer Moon, rising, houses, aspects, or current transits when the app does not provide them.

- [Fictional sample reading](https://unifiedreading.com/sample): See the report without entering personal details.
- [About and method](https://unifiedreading.com/about): Scope, calculations, limitations, and pricing model.
- [Privacy](https://unifiedreading.com/privacy): Data processing, provider routing, caching, and payment details.
- [Pricing](https://unifiedreading.com/pricing): Current cost and scope of the full reading.
- [Contact](https://unifiedreading.com/contact): Public issue tracker and private payment support guidance.

## Limits

There is no public API for submitting someone else's birth details. Ask the person to use the site's form directly; never put sensitive birth or payment information in a public GitHub issue.
